baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequence قَرْيَةٍ ... عَتَتْ ... فَحَاسَبْنَاهَا makes a gathered settlement the subject of both refusal and reckoning.
baseline_models.mechanism: The settlement is a collective place-person, its departure from binding authority is civic rather than merely private, and the doubled accounting language converts the response into an exact communal ledger. Severity is the tightening of that ledger before it becomes painful enforcement and a hard-to-recognize result.

activation_trace.role: The gathering of people in a settlement supplies the collective unit that can incur a shared ledger.
Proud departure from obedience makes the settlement's breach deliberate rather than accidental.
Binding request and obligation give the civic refusal a determinate normative object.
Lordship and ownership locate the obligation within a relation of governing authority.
Carried messages and their bearers make that authority communicative and publicly mediated.
Counting and accounting turn the doubled verb-noun construction into an exact civic reckoning.
A tightened bond lets severity describe the account's binding exactness as well as its harshness.
Painful punishment supplies the enforcement phase that follows the settled account.
The strange, severe, barely recognizable result marks the extremity of enforcement.

changed_reading.before: A town disobeys and receives a generically severe punishment.
changed_reading.after: A civic collective rejects publicly mediated authority, is entered into a tightly binding ledger, and then undergoes enforcement of that settled account.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The linked phrase أَمْرِ رَبِّهَا وَرُسُلِهِ can carry deliberation, covenant, and correspondence alongside command.
baseline_models.mechanism: The focus can stage a failure of relational governance: counsel is refused, a lordly covenant is broken, and correspondence through messengers no longer circulates. Practical oversight then becomes adversarial accounting. This does not erase command; it specifies one social mechanism by which command reaches and binds a settlement.

activation_trace.role: Refusal of obedience supplies the break in an otherwise relational chain of governance.
Consultation and considered resolve make command a process of governed deliberation, not only an issued imperative.
Covenant and compact give lordship a binding relational form.
Correspondence and keeping pace supply the channel through which covenantal governance remains reciprocal and current.
Practical inspection of an affair turns broken communication into accountable administrative review.

changed_reading.before: The settlement simply refuses a unilateral decree.
changed_reading.after: The settlement breaks a covenantal system of counsel and messenger-mediated correspondence, causing practical oversight to harden into judgment.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The split mapping of رَبِّهَا activates both nurture and growth beside عَتَتْ, whose branch can mark terminal age or an irreparable state.
baseline_models.mechanism: The packet supplies a gathered body, nurture, increase, and a terminally hardened condition. I infer a developmental arc: the settlement grows under care but converts growth into overgrowth, reaching a condition resistant to repair; its punishment is then a change so drastic that its prior civic identity is no longer recognizable.

activation_trace.role: Things collected in a settled receptacle let the city behave as an accumulating civic body.
Repair, education, and gradual completion supply the city's prior history of being cultivated.
Increase and rising preserve the non-dominant split-root image of growth that can become excess.
Feeding and maturation make growth a nurtured process rather than an unrelated pun.
Advanced age and an end-state beyond easy repair supply the point where maturation hardens.
Transformation into an unknown or hated form supplies the terminal loss of civic recognizability.

changed_reading.before: A mature settlement becomes morally arrogant.
changed_reading.after: A settlement cultivated into growth crosses into resistant overgrowth, and judgment interrupts that developmental trajectory by changing its recognizable form.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: قَرْيَةٍ, رَبِّهَا, and the doubled عَذَّبْنَاهَا عَذَابًا allow hospitality, nurture, and deprivation to form a second material mechanism.
baseline_models.mechanism: A settlement is imagined as a host and provision-container sustained through cultivation. Its refusal breaches that economy of care; accounting inspects the failed stewardship, while punishment operates as enforced deprivation or weaning that alters the settlement's familiar state.

activation_trace.role: Food gathered for a guest makes the settlement a site with affirmative duties of provision.
Cultivation and repair supply the sustaining care that the settlement receives and should reproduce.
Practical oversight inspects whether the gathered resources were stewarded as care.
Withholding and weaning turn punishment into the removal of sustaining access.
Change into an unfamiliar condition supplies deprivation's visible civic result.

changed_reading.before: Punishment is only externally inflicted pain.
changed_reading.after: Punishment can also be the withdrawal of a nurtured provisioning relation from a settlement that failed its own duty of care.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening legal sequence makes counting, housing, and bounded conduct concrete at household scale. When the focus later makes an entire settlement the object of doubled accounting, the civic ledger can test whether its institutions protected housed and vulnerable persons through measured procedures instead of crossing limits.

activation_trace.role: The people-place collective lets household practices aggregate into a settlement-level responsibility.
Exact accounting receives the accumulated household-scale counts as a civic ledger.
A formally counted waiting period supplies the concrete temporal unit whose observance can be audited.
Exhaustive counting sharpens the focus account from a vague review into exact enumeration.
The dwelling as shelter identifies the protected social space on which civic conduct is tested.
A barrier and discriminating limit gives the audited procedures enforceable edges.
Crossing a limit through wrong supplies the local action that scales into civic rebellion.

structural_cues: 65:1 places counted time, protected dwellings, repeated limits, and their transgression in one procedural sequence.
The focus shifts the grammatical subject from regulated persons to a whole قَرْيَة while retaining doubled accounting language.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies household counts, shelter, and limits; I scale repeated household violations into institutional liability of the qarya. A live alternative is that the legal scene only exemplifies obedience generally and does not specify the town's historical offense.

changed_reading.before: The settlement is judged for abstract collective disobedience.
changed_reading.after: The settlement's severe account can audit how its institutions counted obligations, preserved shelter, and prevented boundary-crossing against vulnerable members.

context_deltas.mechanism: Capacity, constriction, burden, and prior gift provide a proportionality rule. Joined to accounting and the image of a tightened bond, شَدِيدًا can mark not only maximal pain but a strict fit: each charge is bound to what the settlement possessed, received, and could bear.

activation_trace.role: Accounting supplies the operation that compares obligation, receipt, and response.
Tight binding makes severity the firmness of the match rather than unmeasured excess alone.
Breadth of capacity supplies the upper range against which duty is calibrated.
Constriction to a small measure supplies the lower range without canceling obligation.
A carried hardship or right names the burden that must be proportioned.
Prior giving establishes the resource side of the liability equation.

structural_cues: 65:7 moves from expansive means to constrained provision and then states that no self is burdened beyond what it was given.
The focus places شَدِيدًا directly on حِسَابًا, allowing strictness to qualify calculation before it qualifies punishment.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies capacity, narrowed measure, burden, and gift; I infer a proportional liability rule and read tightness as precision. The materially live alternative is the ordinary reading of شديد as sheer intensity, which remains present rather than being displaced.

changed_reading.before: A severe account means an exceptionally harsh reckoning.
changed_reading.after: A severe account can be a rigorously proportional reckoning that binds liability to the settlement's received resources and actual capacity, while still yielding harsh consequences.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same root that names the focus reckoning earlier holds both failed expectation and sufficiency: provision arrives from where a person does not calculate, while God is enough for the one who relies. The focus then reverses positions; the collective that cannot master provision by its own calculus becomes the object of a calculus that is fully sufficient.

activation_trace.role: Exact reckoning supplies the final side of the reciprocal calculus.
Apportioned giving supplies the material that exceeds the recipient's predictive ledger.
Supposition and uncertain estimation supply the human calculus that unexpected provision defeats.
Sufficiency and adequacy supply the counter-pole to uncertain human estimation.
Reliance supplies the alternative to treating one's own estimate as self-sufficient.

structural_cues: 65:3 places unexpected provision, لا يحتسب, reliance, and فهو حسبه in a tight sequence before the focus repeats the root as حاسبناها حسابا.
The focus changes the settlement from calculating subject to calculated object.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the repeated root with estimate, sufficiency, and accounting branches; I infer a reversal between deficient civic self-calculation and an adequate divine reckoning. An alternative is simple verbal recurrence without an accusation of self-sufficiency.

changed_reading.before: The account only inventories completed offenses.
changed_reading.after: The account also overturns a settlement's false calculus of control: what it could not predict or make sufficient is answered by a reckoning that lacks that deficit.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier instruction to deliberate between parties in recognized good activates the consultation branch inside أَمْرِ رَبِّهَا. The settlement's rebellion can therefore include refusal to make authority operative through reciprocal, socially intelligible negotiation precisely when relations become difficult.

activation_trace.role: Obligation preserves the non-negotiable normative force of the command.
Consultation and resolve supply a social mode through which that obligation is administered.
Mutual deliberation makes the consultative branch explicit in the immediate legal context.
A connection maintained between parties supplies the relational space in which deliberation must work.
Recognized good supplies the shared practical norm governing negotiation.
Mutual obstruction and crooked difficulty identify the pressure under which consultation can fail.

structural_cues: 65:6 joins duties of housing, provision, payment, and وأتمروا بينكم بمعروف before naming mutual difficulty.
65:8 uses أمر with both lordship and messengers, retaining vertical authority and mediated social implementation together.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies explicit mutual consultation and recognized good; I infer that a town can rebel by disabling this implementation layer of command. The live alternative is that ائتمار in 65:6 is local advice while أمر in 65:8 remains solely a decree.

changed_reading.before: Rebellion is refusal to hear an order.
changed_reading.after: Rebellion can be institutional refusal to translate binding authority into consultation, recognized good, and workable relations under pressure.

context_deltas.mechanism: Timed endpoints, witnesses, justice, reminder, and sequential recitation activate the messenger branches of deliberateness and successive arrival. The severe accounting can thus be the terminus of a paced notice process rather than an unannounced reaction.

activation_trace.role: Deliberate pacing and patience give messenger communication a non-summary temporal form.
Successive groups make رسل compatible with repeated notice rather than one isolated delivery.
A fixed temporal endpoint supplies the measured duration before a decision closes.
Presence with observation supplies public attestability to the process.
Justice in judgment supplies the norm for witnessed procedure.
A reminder that causes recollection supplies renewed notice after forgetfulness.
The explicit message-bearer identifies the agent of the notice process.
Following and succession make the communicated signs a sequence that can accumulate evidentiary force.

structural_cues: The context repeatedly orders waiting, witnessing, reminding, and sequential recitation before and after the focus judgment.
The focus uses the plural رسله and places accounting after rebellion with فـ, supporting culmination after communication.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies procedural timing, witnesses, reminder, and sequential messaging; I infer an analogy between those safeguards and notice before civic judgment. The alternative is that the legal safeguards and the town narratives remain distinct domains with only general moral continuity.

changed_reading.before: The punishment follows a bare finding of disobedience.
changed_reading.after: The account can close a repeated, paced, witnessed communication process whose accumulated notices the settlement persistently refused.

context_deltas.mechanism: The next ayah makes the settlement taste the unwholesome weight of its own affair and names its final remainder as loss. That sequence supplies an endogenous feedback path: divine accounting exposes a deficit already generated by civic conduct, and divine punishment is realized through the affair's own damaging consequence. Direct divine agency and internal consequence remain coexisting readings.

activation_trace.role: Accounting supplies the disclosure and settlement of the deficit generated by conduct.
Painful punishment preserves explicit divine enforcement within the feedback model.
Experienced trial turns consequence from an external report into a condition undergone by the town itself.
Unwholesomeness and failure to digest make the town's affair recoil as its own harmful intake.
The town's own affair supplies the internal process whose consequence it experiences.
The last part and outcome supply the temporal endpoint of the feedback chain.
General deficit names what the severe account finally reveals.

structural_cues: 65:9 immediately resumes the town's feminine singular subject and twice attributes the affair to it with أمرها.
Taste, harmful weight, outcome, and loss form a causal sequence after the two divine first-person plural verbs in 65:8.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the town's own affair, tasted unwholesomeness, outcome, and deficit; I infer that punishment can operate through consequences immanent in that affair. The live alternative is a wholly external punishment whose effects are merely described as tasting one's affair.

changed_reading.before: Accounting and punishment arrive from outside the town's own operation.
changed_reading.after: Accounting reveals the deficit in the town's own civic affair, and punishment can be both divinely imposed and internally realized as that affair's unwholesome outcome.

context_deltas.mechanism: The messenger's sequential, manifest signs disclose meaning and bring hidden conditions into clarity; encompassing knowledge guarantees that nothing material to the account remains concealed. Refusing messengers therefore becomes refusal of recognizability itself. The result answers symmetrically: investigative accounting reveals the hidden record, while نكرا marks an outcome that the town can no longer recognize as its former condition.

activation_trace.role: Message-bearing supplies the disclosure channel that the settlement rejects.
Inquiry and testing for information let accounting function as exposure of the civic record.
Change into an unknown condition supplies the reversed recognizability at the end of the process.
The explicit messenger confirms that carried communication is the agent of disclosure.
Following in sequence gives disclosure cumulative movement rather than a static sign.
A manifest marker makes what must be recognized perceptible.
Clarifying meaning by speech or sign supplies the interpretive action of the verses.
Bringing something out of concealment supplies the transition from hidden civic condition to exposed state.
Manifest clarity supplies the destination of successful disclosure.
Disclosure to a knower supplies the epistemic completion of the signs' work.
Complete enclosure in knowledge makes concealment from the final account impossible.

structural_cues: 65:11 forms a chain from messenger to recited signs to clarification to emergence from darkness into light.
65:12 closes with knowledge enclosing every thing, while 65:8 closes with an unrecognizable punishment.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies signs, clarification, emergence, light, knowledge, and enclosure; I infer a symmetry in which refusal of disclosure ends in forced disclosure and lost self-recognition. A live alternative treats نكرا only as dreadful, without the recognizability reversal.

changed_reading.before: The town rejects messengers and later suffers a strange punishment.
changed_reading.after: The town rejects a pathway that would make its condition intelligible; accounting then exposes what it hid, and punishment returns its refusal of recognition as a loss of recognizable civic form.

context_deltas.mechanism: The final ayah spatializes command as descending and operating between corresponding cosmic levels, while knowledge encircles every thing. Read back into عَتَتْ عَنْ أَمْرِ, the settlement attempts a lateral departure from an order that has no ungoverned outside; accounting is the moment that this impossible exemption is demonstrated.

activation_trace.role: A bounded human settlement supplies the local unit attempting to detach from a larger order.
Departure from obedience supplies the attempted movement outside that order.
Affair and ordering condition supply what permeates levels rather than remaining a detached utterance.
Descent and arrival supply the vertical motion by which order reaches created levels.
The affair itself is the descending element, linking the focus command to a pervasive ordering process.
A connection standing between levels supplies the relational mesh through which command operates.
Complete knowability supplies the epistemic side of there being no exempt outside.
Total enclosure in knowledge closes the imagined escape route from the order.

structural_cues: 65:8 uses the departure construction عتت عن أمر, while 65:12 depicts الأمر descending between all corresponding levels.
The pericope ends with كل شيء repeated under power and encompassing knowledge.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies descent, between-ness, and total enclosure; I supply the spatial arrow that treats عن as an attempted exit from a pervasive order. The alternative is a non-spatial statement of disobedience followed by a general cosmological proof of authority.

changed_reading.before: A local polity rejects a command coming to it from outside.
changed_reading.after: A local polity attempts to exempt itself from an order already descending through and connecting every level; reckoning demonstrates that the claimed outside never existed.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the sweetness branch of ع ذ ب is form-distant from the ordinary punishment sense. It remains anchored in the doubled focus root and is activated by the next ayah's explicit tasting, unwholesomeness, and later nourishing provision. Downstream prose should present it as a sensory counter-reading or word-field reversal, not as a replacement etymology for عذاب.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The doubled عَذَّبْنَاهَا عَذَابًا is followed immediately by فَذَاقَتْ وَبَالَ and can carry an exploratory sweetness-withholding reversal.

activation_trace.role: Sweet, palatable water and food supply the sensory good whose reversal makes punishment materially felt.
Withholding and weaning supply the mechanism by which access to the palatable is removed.
Literal tasting activates the palate as the scene on which consequence is registered.
Unwholesomeness and failure to digest supply the bitter result of the reversal.
Nourishing provision preserves the positive alimentary pole against which deprivation is read.

changed_reading.before: The town is made to feel severe pain.
changed_reading.after: The town that rejected sustaining order is weaned from what is wholesome and made to taste the indigestible product of its own affair.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is a cross-domain structural analogy activated by a rare qarya branch, so it should not be asserted as the lexical sense of the verse. It remains valid as an anchored model because قَرْيَةٍ can image timbers bearing a house-pole, شَدِيدًا can tighten bonds, and the context foregrounds dwellings and carried obligations. Render it explicitly as a material analogy for civic support under load.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The ق ر ي branch of timbers carrying a house-pole combines with the focus's tightened account to image a settlement as a load-bearing support system.

activation_trace.role: Timbers carrying the head of a house-pole supply the settlement's material support geometry.
Tightened bonds supply the stress and fastening by which the support system is tested.
The dwelling as shelter identifies what the civic supports are meant to hold.
Inhabiting a dwelling turns structural support into a concrete social duty of housing.
Bearing an entrusted load supplies the social weight placed on the settlement's supports.

changed_reading.before: The qarya is merely the location and population of rebellion.
changed_reading.after: The qarya can be carried as a civic support frame whose refusal to bear household obligations is exposed when a strict account loads and tests every fastening.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This bodily reading is deliberately strange: it combines packet branches for material gathered in a wound, an internal discharge, a sore emerging, and hidden corruption. It remains anchored in قَرْيَةٍ, نُّكْرًا, and the context's exit/entry contrast, but downstream prose must call it an organic analogy for accumulated civic damage, not a literal medical decoding.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus joins a qarya branch that gathers matter in a wound to a نكر branch for discharge from within, allowing accounting and punishment to image the opening of concealed civic corruption.

activation_trace.role: Collection in a settled receptacle, including matter gathered in a wound, supplies the city's accumulating interior.
Painful punishment supplies the pressure and injury of exposing the accumulated condition.
Blood, pus, or discharge emerging from within supplies the unsettling material result.
A sore that exits the body activates the image of concealed damage breaking the surface.
Hidden internal corruption supplies what the civic body had contained before exposure.

changed_reading.before: Judgment strikes an otherwise coherent settlement from outside.
changed_reading.after: Judgment can expose a settlement as a container where hidden damage accumulated until the account opened it and its own unrecognizable contents emerged.

strongest_changes: The household counts, shelters, and limits of 65:1 scale the focus account into an audit of civic treatment of vulnerable persons.
Capacity, constricted measure, burden, and prior gift recast severe accounting as rigorously proportional as well as harsh.
The repeated ح س ب field reverses the town from a deficient calculating subject into the object of an adequate reckoning.
65:6 activates a consultative implementation of command, while the timed and witnessed sequence preserves a due-process reading of the messengers.
65:9 makes punishment coexist with endogenous feedback, and 65:11-12 make rejected disclosure return as exposure, lost recognizability, and demonstrated enclosure.
summary.what_was_special: The focus became a hinge between intimate procedural law and a cosmic order: a qarya could be a civic ledger, a failed covenantal network, an overgrown nurtured body, or a concealed damaged container. The non-dominant ر ب و mapping, the estimate/sufficiency/accounting alternation in ح س ب, and the taste/withholding and load-bearing outliers generated the largest latent changes without forcing them into one final reading.
remaining_uncertainties: The qarya-as-institution scaling is coherent but the packet does not identify the historical town's particular social violations.
Consultation can specify how command is implemented without proving that أمر in the focus itself denotes consultation.
The endogenous-consequence model must coexist with, not neutralize, the focus's explicit divine agency.
The developmental, palatal, architectural, and bodily models depend on branch activation and should remain visibly exploratory.
The spatial no-outside reading of 65:12 is abductive; the cosmological close may instead function as a general proof of power and knowledge.
